paragraphs: Production-minded dark portfolio for Md. Shariful Islam, built with Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind, MongoDB, Better Auth, Cloudinary, React Three Fiber/Drei, and Motion. Public content is published-only; the server-authorized dashboard manages profile/settings, media, certificates, projects, posts, homepage sections, skills, timeline entries, and a private contact inbox. No content database uses localStorage. No invented portfolio entries are seeded.

requirements.text: Create a Google OAuth client of type Web application, configure the consent screen, and add your Google account as a test user while the OAuth application is in testing mode.
Start/restart the application, open /sign-in, sign in with Google, and visit /dashboard.
Still needed to actually sign in and upload: Google client ID/client secret and Cloudinary cloud name/API key/API secret.
